messages.subject: removal of paleobiodb
messages.body_plain:
Hello Wallace users,
Unfortunately, (but hopefully only temporarily), the package `paleobiodb` has been removed from CRAN. This means Wallace no longer offers the option to query the paleo database for occurrence records. The Paleobiology Database website is still up and running, so you can still download occ records from the site and use the User Upload option (remember to use a csv file with "species_name", "longitude", and "latitude" as the first three fields).

Version 2.0.6 will be available on CRAN shortly. In the meantime you can install via github.

Bethany
The Wallace Team
